[{"sha":"12cbd65f0b6591525a22b47c1f4e2d63d41c7c9f","node_id":"C_kwDODS2lZ9oAKDEyY2JkNjVmMGI2NTkxNTI1YTIyYjQ3YzFmNGUyZDYzZDQxYzdjOWY","commit":{"author":{"name":"tom","email":"thmagnitis@gmail.com","date":"2026-07-09T12:00:22Z"},"committer":{"name":"Olli Vanhoja","email":"olli.vanhoja@gmail.com","date":"2026-07-09T12:38:00Z"},"message":"Port transport from node-fetch v2 to undici

node-fetch v2 is effectively end-of-life; undici is Node's built-in,
actively-maintained HTTP client. This swaps the transport internals while
preserving the public API (setup(), retry/retry-after, auto-JSON bodies,
keep-alive) so it remains a drop-in for existing consumers.

Highlights:

- DNS caching now feeds undici's Agent via `connect.lookup` instead of
  rewriting the request URL to the resolved IP. This keeps the original
  hostname for TLS SNI (the URL-rewrite approach broke HTTPS certificate
  validation) while preserving the TTL-aware LRU cache.

- Because DNS caching lives in the dispatcher, undici applies it to every
  redirect hop automatically. This removes the need for the manual redirect
  handling and per-hop agent swapping, so parse-host.ts, redirect.ts and
  agent-wrapper.ts are deleted.

- Adds a `timeout` (ms) option translated to an AbortSignal, since undici
  (unlike node-fetch v2) has no `timeout` option. Combined with any
  caller-supplied signal via AbortSignal.any.

- Legacy agentkeepalive-style agent options (maxSockets, freeSocketTimeout,
  timeout) are mapped onto undici's Agent for backwards compatibility.

Toolchain modernized to match: TypeScript 5, tsc build (undici types need
modern @types/node), undici as a peer dependency, and the jest suite
replaced with a node:test behavior suite (test/undici.test.ts) covering
response shape, auto-JSON/buffer bodies, 5xx + 429/retry-after retries,
retry exhaustion, per-request timeout, redirect follow, and DNS caching.

Requires Node >=
